description: Split text, markdown or a text file into token-sized chunks for retrieval (RAG) and embeddings. Splits at markdown headings (ATX "#" headings, never inside code fences) and paragraphs first, then sentences (lines inside code blocks), and only cuts mid-sentence when a single sentence is longer than maxTokens. Consecutive chunks of the same section share about overlapTokens of text. Each chunk returns index, text, tokens, startChar/endChar (JavaScript string offsets, end exclusive, so text === source.slice(startChar, endChar) once CRLF line endings are normalised to \n) and the heading path it sits under. Tokens are counted with tiktoken (o200k_base by default; for Claude treat counts as estimates). Give "text" or "path" (file path or base64); give "output" to also write the chunks as JSONL (one JSON object per line).

encoding.description: Tokenizer: "o200k_base" (GPT-4o / o-series, default) or "cl100k_base" (GPT-4 / GPT-3.5 / text-embedding-3).

includeText.description: Return each chunk's text inline. Default: true, or false when "output" is given.

markdown.description: Treat "#" lines as section headings (default true). Set false for plain text.

maxChunks.description: Most chunks to return inline (the JSONL file always has all). Default 2000.

output.description: Also write the chunks as JSONL to this file (or folder ending in "/").

overlapTokens.description: Tokens repeated from the end of the previous chunk (same section only). Default 50. Must be below maxTokens.

path.description: Or: a UTF-8 text/markdown file, as a local path or base64 (raw or a data: URI).

name: ai_chunk_text
title: Chunk text for RAG
